title: Decide when a scheduled action is actually ready
description: Change the readiness contract, observed storage state, backlog policy, and configuration layer. The lab separates nominal time from proof that input data is complete.

scenarios.label: Daily warehouse partition
scenarios.detail: One run owns one UTC date and waits for the upstream commit marker.

scenarios.label: Late hourly arrivals
scenarios.detail: Six nominal slots accumulated while the source publisher was unavailable.

scenarios.label: Expired freshness window
scenarios.detail: The data predicate is still false after the coordinator timeout.

dataStates.label: No directory
dataStates.detail: The expected dataset instance has not appeared.

dataStates.label: Directory with partial files
dataStates.detail: Objects exist, but no producer commit marker is present.

dataStates.label: Committed with _SUCCESS
dataStates.detail: The producer published the conventional MapReduce completion marker.

dataStates.label: Committed with _READY
dataStates.detail: The producer published the custom marker required by this contract.

readinessContracts.label: Directory existence
readinessContracts.detail: An empty done-flag treats the directory itself as ready.
readinessContracts.warning: Directory existence is a weak contract when producers write files incrementally.

readinessContracts.label: _SUCCESS marker
readinessContracts.detail: An omitted done-flag uses the conventional _SUCCESS marker.
readinessContracts.warning: Wait for _SUCCESS; files may still be partial before the producer commits.

readinessContracts.label: _READY marker
readinessContracts.detail: A named done-flag requires the selected producer-owned marker.
readinessContracts.warning: Wait for _READY; another marker does not satisfy this dataset contract.

executionStrategies.label: FIFO
executionStrategies.detail: Submit older READY actions before newer ones.

executionStrategies.label: LIFO
executionStrategies.detail: Submit newer READY actions first without discarding older instances.

executionStrategies.label: LAST_ONLY
executionStrategies.detail: Keep only the latest eligible instance when older runs no longer matter.

executionStrategies.label: NONE
executionStrategies.detail: Skip actions that miss the server's small nominal-time tolerance.

configurationLayers.label: Submission config
configurationLayers.detail: job.properties supplies the base parameter used to resolve the application.

configurationLayers.label: Coordinator action config
configurationLayers.detail: The coordinator passes a run-scoped value into the materialized workflow.

configurationLayers.label: Action-local config
configurationLayers.detail: The action configuration is the final workflow layer for this property.

notice: This is a state model, not a timing benchmark. Verify exact precedence, timeout, and execution behavior against the deployed Oozie 5.2.1 configuration before changing a production coordinator.
